scenes.text: Balaji just posted a bounty. Two thousand and forty-eight dollars.
Prove anyone can run their own Farcaster. No API keys. No permission.
Farcaster is a social network nobody owns. It lives on nodes anyone can run.
So I turned it into three commands.
First, rent a server. A few dollars a day.
Then run your own node. It downloads the entire network.
One shard came back five hundred and seventy days behind.
So I fixed it, and sent the fix upstream.
An hour later, fully in sync.
Then your own client. It makes its own key. No gas.
And I posted. From my own node.
Your turn. Open source, step by step. Link below.
